_comment: GROUND TRUTH, DRAWN BY THE OWNER 2026-08-27, one square per bird, head to tail.
This exists because every automatic detector tried on this problem was
unusable. The energy margin audit flagged 93.8% of all icons and produced
false positives on bkcchi and comcra when checked by eye. The head anchor
lands on the BACK of a horizontal bird, which is why the crop slides to the
wrong end. So the labels here are the measurement, and the algorithm is the
thing under test - never the other way round (F190: a metric computed from
the decision it audits cannot fail).
slide      where the fixed-size square sits in its slide range, 0..1.
size_ratio the owner's square divided by min(w,h). 1.0 means the crop the
cropper can actually make; <1 means a tighter ZOOM it cannot do;
>1 means the bird does NOT FIT and needs padding or a new photo.
verdict    CAN / ZOOM / NOFIT, derived from size_ratio.
